title: Ashley Boosts His Real Estate Empire With Harvey Nichols

A Bloomberg analysis of property records shows that Frasers Group now owns around 8 million square feet of retail park and shopping center space, part of what the company’s CEO Michael Murray said is a 16 million-square-foot portfolio worth £2 billion ($2.7 billion). Bloomberg's Maddie Parker has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

Bloomberg's Jack Farchy reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
